svg.aria-label: Map of the 16 chapters. Foundations (1 scale from zero to millions, 2 back-of-the-envelope math, 3 the 4-step framework) are used in every chapter. Building blocks: 4 rate limiter, 5 consistent hashing, 6 key-value store, 7 unique ID generator. Full systems: 8 URL shortener, 9 web crawler, 10 notification system, 11 news feed, 12 chat system, 13 search autocomplete, 14 YouTube, 15 Google Drive. The rate limiter is reused in chapters 8, 10 and 11; consistent hashing in 6, 9 and 11; the key-value store in 12; the ID generator in 8 and 12. Chapter 16 is a reading list.
svg.title: Chapter map
